first_contact_implications.none: normally protected from overt Starfleet contact absent exceptional contamination/emergency/legal context
first_contact_implications.theoretical: not sufficient by itself for overt contact
first_contact_implications.active_research: observation and preparation may intensify; overt contact still not automatic
first_contact_implications.first_successful_warp_flight: major contact threshold; initiate readiness assessment, not automatic hail
first_contact_implications.interstellar_warp_operations: contact becomes increasingly likely/necessary if mutual encounter occurs

rules: Technology band is multi-domain; one exceptional domain does not automatically uplift every other domain.
Warp technology may be externally contaminated or independently developed; provenance matters.
A warp-capable civilization can still be politically/socially unready for public contact.
Technology constrains generated infrastructure, weapons, medicine, ships and signatures.
No future Federation technology is granted to a newly generated civilization for balance convenience.
